changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO itibari.call_status (public_id, code, description, active, deleted, creation_time) SELECT CAST('d4e5f6a7-b8c9-4123-def0-000000000001' AS UUID), 'ON_HOLD', 'On hold', true, false, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM itibari.call_status cs WHERE UPPER(cs.code) = 'ON_HOLD' AND cs.deleted = false);

changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_delivery_agent_active_session ON itibari.delivery_agent_login_sessions (delivery_agent_id) WHERE active = true AND deleted = false

changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: UPDATE itibari.cash_credit_recon_report_lines SET deleted = true WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY report_id, route_public_id ORDER BY creation_time NULLS LAST, id ) AS duplicate_number FROM itibari.cash_credit_recon_report_lines WHERE deleted = false ) duplicates WHERE duplicate_number > 1 );
